plain_description.what: A simulated arena with 12 models was run at the real campaign's match budget, with a simulated noisy judge. It compared a single-elimination tournament with this framework's adaptive, cell-stratified match scheduler. No calls were made.
plain_description.why: It checks whether the framework's scheduler spends a fixed budget better than a simpler published tournament design.
plain_description.information: If the tournament won, the scheduler would be unnecessary. Result: done, on simulation only. The tournament does not win. The overall ranking is about equal at realistic noise and favours the framework at high noise. The framework makes 4 to 13 times fewer top-4 order errors and is slightly better per cell. The round-robin per-cell comparison was not comparable. It uses an older-family schedule, so it counts for planning only.
